mapper.select: SELECT g.group_id AS groupId, g.name AS name, g.region_name AS regionName, g.latitude AS latitude, g.longitude AS longitude, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM group_member gm WHERE gm.group_id = g.group_id AND gm.status = 'ACTIVE') AS memberCount, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM group_member me WHERE me.group_id = g.group_id AND me.user_key = #{userKey} AND me.status = 'ACTIVE') AS isMember FROM `group` g WHERE g.latitude IS NOT NULL AND g.longitude IS NOT NULL ORDER BY g.group_id DESC

SELECT gs.schedule_id AS scheduleId, gs.group_id AS groupId, g.name AS groupName, gs.title AS title, gs.start_at AS startAt, gs.location_name AS locationName, gs.latitude AS latitude, gs.longitude AS longitude FROM group_schedule gs JOIN `group` g ON g.group_id = gs.group_id JOIN group_member gm ON gm.group_id = gs.group_id AND gm.user_key = #{userKey} AND gm.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE gs.status = 'CONFIRMED' AND gs.latitude IS NOT NULL AND gs.longitude IS NOT NULL AND gs.start_at >= #{from} AND gs.start_at < #{to} ORDER BY gs.start_at ASC
